evidence.quote: the e2e suite asserts that saving a memory enrolls its creator as a reviewer

observations.why: The suite asserting a behavioral expectation frames correctness of the enrollment mechanism as the appealed-to good — a competence value, the craft working as specified.

evidence.quote: This probe memory exists only to carry that assertion

observations.why: Framing the memory as an instrument whose sole purpose is to carry an assertion positions the test artifact as a vehicle for verifying system correctness — competence as the motive.
